content_of_post_to_comment: I recently took some ibuprofen for a headache I had , It took away all the pain plus all the minor pains in my body and it make me feel like I was 15y..I finished a project I was delaying for months in 20 minutes,cleaned the house and did most of my todo list in half day..I am not lazy ..I just need a little something to take away the pain and make me feel a little better, even if I don't hurt there is something keeping me down ,maybe some minor inflamation is keeping my energy low. I know I can not be taking Ibuprofen everyday to feel baseline .If someone has solved this let me know please..
comment: I’ve had a similar realization that sometimes what feels like laziness is actually feeling worn down or running on a low battery. The ibuprofen effect is interesting, but it might be worth looking beyond inflammation too—sleep quality, stress, deficiencies, chronic tension, or something else could be playing a role. Feeling dramatically different from one small change is probably a clue worth investigating rather than just masking it daily.
